# Agent Working Memory Schema — `travel-assist`

This file defines the structured memory an AI agent should maintain across a coding session on this codebase.
It is tailored to the **Kotlin / Spring Boot 4.0.4** stack, the layered `Controller → Service → Repository` architecture,
and the specific domain concepts (Trip, TripDto, TripService, etc.) found in this project.

---

## How to Use This File

- The agent **reads** this file at the start of every turn to restore context.
- The agent **writes** updates to the `## Live Session Memory` YAML block after every meaningful action.
- The human reviewer reads `open_questions` to know when a decision requires their input.
- Nothing in `## Live Session Memory` should be edited by hand — use `agent-context.json` for static overrides.

---

## Schema Reference (field definitions and allowed values)

```yaml
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SECTION 1 — session_state
# Tracks the current task, its lifecycle phase, and any blocking
# context the agent needs to resume work correctly after an
# interruption or a context-window reset.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
session_state:
  task_id: string              # Short unique label for the current task, e.g. "add-search-endpoint"
  task_description: string     # One-sentence human-readable description of what is being built or fixed
  status: string               # One of: not_started | in_progress | blocked | awaiting_review | done
  phase: string                # One of: planning | scaffolding | implementing | testing | refactoring | reviewing
  entry_point_confirmed: bool  # Whether TravelAssistApplication.kt has been verified as the correct boot entry
  active_module: string        # The Spring Modulith module or package currently being modified,
                               # e.g. "controller", "service", "repository", "model", "dto"
  last_action: string          # Prose description of the last concrete action taken (file written, test run, etc.)
  next_action: string          # Prose description of the next planned action
  blocking_reason: string|null # If status=blocked, why. Otherwise null.
  turn_count: int              # Monotonically increasing counter; increment each agent turn for traceability


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SECTION 2 — decisions_made
# An append-only list. Each entry records a single architectural
# or implementation decision with full rationale so future turns
# (or a new agent session) can understand WHY, not just WHAT.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
decisions_made:
  - decision_id: string        # Short slug, e.g. "use-transactional-readonly-on-get"
    timestamp: string          # ISO-8601 datetime, e.g. "2025-07-14T10:32:00Z"
    component: string          # The key_component name affected, e.g. "TripService"
    file_path: string          # Relative path to the primary file affected
    decision: string           # One sentence: what was decided
    rationale: string          # Why this choice over alternatives; reference framework constraints where relevant
    alternatives_considered:   # List of other options that were explicitly rejected
      - string
    kotlin_notes: string|null  # Any Kotlin-specific nuance (e.g. data class limitation, null safety implication)
    spring_notes: string|null  # Any Spring Boot 4.x / JPA / Modulith constraint that drove the decision
    reversible: bool           # Whether this decision can be cleanly undone without cascading changes


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SECTION 3 — files_modified
# One entry per file touched in this session. Tracks the reason
# for the change, the nature of the edit, and any fragility
# warnings so the agent doesn't break invariants on re-entry.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
files_modified:
  - path: string               # Relative path from repo root, e.g. "src/main/kotlin/…/TripService.kt"
    module: string             # Logical module: controller | service | repository | model | dto | config | test | root
    change_type: string        # One of: created | modified | deleted | renamed
    change_summary: string     # What changed and why, in one or two sentences
    depends_on:                # Other files in this session whose changes must be in sync with this one
      - string
    validation_needed: bool    # True if Jakarta validation annotations were added/changed on a DTO or entity
    jpa_entity_touched: bool   # True if the Trip JPA entity itself was modified (triggers migration awareness)
    dto_entity_sync: bool      # True if both TripDto and Trip must stay structurally aligned after this change
    test_coverage_exists: bool # Whether a corresponding test class exists for this file
    fragility_notes: string|null  # Known pitfalls from potential_pitfalls relevant to this file, or null


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SECTION 4 — tests_run
# Records every test execution within the session so the agent
# can reason about what is currently green, red, or untested.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
tests_run:
  - run_id: string             # e.g. "run-001"
    timestamp: string          # ISO-8601 datetime
    command: string            # Exact command executed, e.g. "./gradlew test" or "./gradlew test --tests TripServiceTest"
    scope: string              # One of: full_suite | single_class | single_method | integration | native_compile
    test_class: string|null    # Fully-qualified class name if scope is not full_suite, else null
    result: string             # One of: passed | failed | errored | skipped
    failed_tests:              # List of failing test method names; empty list if result=passed
      - string
    error_summary: string|null # Short description of compile error or exception if result=errored
    coverage_delta: string|null # Qualitative note on coverage change, e.g. "TripService now fully covered"
    h2_schema_issue: bool      # True if failure appears related to H2 DDL / schema auto-generation
    spring_context_loaded: bool  # Whether the full Spring ApplicationContext started successfully in this run


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SECTION 5 — open_questions
# Items that require human clarification before the agent can
# safely proceed. The agent must NOT guess on these — it must
# pause and surface them.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
open_questions:
  - question_id: string        # Short slug, e.g. "confirm-graphql-schema-location"
    raised_at_turn: int        # turn_count value when this question was raised
    component: string          # Which key_component or concept this blocks
    question: string           # The exact question for the human reviewer
    impact_if_unresolved: string  # What the agent cannot do until this is answered
    suggested_default: string|null  # Agent's best-guess default if human approves proceeding; null if genuinely unknown
    resolution: string|null    # Filled in once the human answers; null while open
    resolved_at_turn: int|null # turn_count when resolved; null while open


# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# SECTION 6 — domain_state
# Kotlin- and framework-specific runtime state that must be
# remembered across turns: entity shape, validation rules in
# effect, active Spring beans, known config conflicts, etc.
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
domain_state:

  # --- Trip entity shape (mirrors model/Trip.kt) ---
  trip_entity:
    current_fields:            # List of field names currently on the Trip JPA entity
      - string
    id_strategy: string        # JPA id generation strategy in use, e.g. "IDENTITY"
    table_name: string         # Value of @Table(name=…), e.g. "trips"
    mutable_fields:            # Fields declared as `var` (safe to update via JPA)
      - string
    immutable_fields:          # Fields declared as `val` (cannot be updated after construction)
      - string
    pending_schema_changes: bool  # True if entity fields changed but H2 schema has not been verified to reflect it

  # --- TripDto validation rules in effect ---
  trip_dto:
    current_fields:            # List of field names on TripDto
      - string
    validated_fields:          # Fields carrying Jakarta validation annotations (e.g. @NotBlank)
      - field: string
        constraint: string     # e.g. "@NotBlank", "@NotNull", "@Size(max=255)"
    annotation_target_flag_active: bool  # Whether -Xannotation-default-target=param-property compiler flag is set
                                         # CRITICAL: removing this breaks Jakarta validation on Kotlin data classes

  # --- Active REST API surface ---
  api_endpoints:               # Current endpoints exposed by TripController
    - method: string           # HTTP verb: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE
      path: string             # e.g. "/api/trips/{id}"
      handler: string          # Kotlin function name in TripController
      request_body: string|null  # DTO type name if body expected, else null
      response_type: string    # Return type, e.g. "Trip", "List<Trip>", "ResponseEntity<Trip>"
      status_codes:            # Expected HTTP status codes this endpoint can return
        - int

  # --- Spring context health ---
  spring_context:
    boot_version: string       # e.g. "4.0.4" — flag if ever changed
    database: string           # Active database, e.g. "H2 in-memory"
    jpa_ddl_auto: string       # Value of spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto, e.g. "create-drop"
    config_files_active:       # Which config files are currently in use (both may exist — watch for conflicts)
      - string                 # "application.properties" | "application.yml"
    conflicting_config_keys:   # Any keys defined in both .properties and .yml — must be resolved
      - string
    docker_compose_active: bool  # Whether compose.yaml is being used via spring-boot-docker-compose
    modulith_modules_defined:  # List of Spring Modulith module names explicitly declared, if any
      - string

  # --- Build and codegen state ---
  build_state:
    last_successful_build: string|null  # ISO-8601 datetime of last clean `./gradlew build`, null if never run
    dgs_codegen_schemas_present: bool   # Whether graphql-client schema files exist under src/main/resources/graphql-client
                                        # If false, `generateJava` task will fail — do not run full build
    native_image_attempted: bool        # Whether GraalVM native compilation has been attempted this session
    lombok_usage_confirmed: bool        # Whether any Kotlin file is actually using Lombok (likely none — see pitfalls)
    gradle_cache_clean: bool            # Whether `./gradlew clean` has been run since last entity/config change
```
